title: CloudzAuraPack
description: my custom resource pack i made that contains a bunch of qol and a bunch of other cool stuff if u wanna download it and check it out u can i dont gatekeep obv thanks for checking this out.
body: my resource pack that contains a bunch of qol stuff and custom stuff including custom elytra sword gaps pearls small items custom particles mace low shield and fire custom panorama and a bunch of other cloud/blue themed stuff. particles contain totem pop death particles crit and hit particles white/cloud hearts cloud food icons. has a few custom advancements custom panorama custom skybox and a bunch more other stuff that i did not mention but u can check it out if u want its pretty good.
